semantic_verification_standard: Exact description semantics, mounted runtime reachability, distinctive invariants, failure behavior and honest caveats. Text-to-ledger coverage or a passing generic row-ID test is insufficient.

lanes.first_requirement: Universal multi-field creation, application structuring, tool discovery and resilient result-seeking
lanes.instruction: Re-read every assigned row requirement and exact description from the fresh Google Doc export. Inspect implementation, mounted route, and named test. A generic dispatcher, label echo, placeholder, nearby method, acceptance-only test, or title keyword match does not pass. Fix every semantic mismatch; add distinctive output invariants, invalid-input/failure-mode tests, and mounted HTTP tests. Update ledger evidence/caveats only after focused and full suite pass.
